function print() { console.log("print"); }
function close() { return 1; }
function confirm(value: string | undefined) { return value !== undefined; }
function getSelection(): Selection | null { return null; }
function open(url?: string | URL): WindowProxy | null { return null; }
print();
console.log(close(), confirm("yes"), confirm(), getSelection(), open("file"));
console.log(getSelection()?.anchorNode, open()?.closed);
